# Analytics Engine Overview

*Navigation: [[index|← StashStats Index]] / [[architecture|System Architecture]] / Analytics Engine Overview*

The analytics engine processes raw inventory data and chronological logs into structured metric summaries, charts, and forecasts.

## Analytical Domains

1. **Categorical Distributions**: Aggregates inventory volume across yarn weights, fiber types, color families, and brands. See [[analytics-distributions|Categorical Distributions]].
2. **Consumption Velocity**: Tracks net inventory inflow vs. outflow, calculating monthly burn rates and estimated stash lifespan. See [[analytics-velocity|Consumption Velocity & Horizon]].
3. **Project Metrics**: Computes project completion cadence, queue depth, and fiber usage rates. See [[analytics-projects|Project Analytics]].

## Performance & Caching

Calculations are memoized in memory and backed by Redis caches to ensure sub-100ms dashboard re-renders upon user filtering.
